subject: mt-info
title: MT.INFO.------V.SY.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 265 (PR.S(RD)II-19). MT-INFO (multi-information) is the subject; V-SY (value system) is the partner. From the subject: AFL (affinity alignment), CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis) and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From AFL: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) and OBS (observation). From CULT-INFO-B: DEF (definition) and PRI-INFO (principle information). From SPT-DY: AFI (affinity insight). From INDIV-TD: PER-DY (perception dynamics). From AFI: ATTN (attraction). From ATTN: RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits).
